title: December, 2005
logline: Does Chloe come home. She does. She and Wood sit on Gully's dock and don't talk about the lot in Newport.

panels.composition: Gully's dock, December dusk, the shop lit behind. CHLOE at the end — the strip draws her at twenty-five: short hair now, a city coat, the eyeliner. WOOD sitting down beside her. BARNABY between, slower.

image.prompt: a young woman with short dark hair in a city coat sitting at the end of a wooden dock at winter dusk, a young man sitting down beside her, a gray-muzzled dog settling between them, a lit shingle shop behind, muddy watercolor
image.notes: Chloe at 25: the chloe_28 model, younger. Short hair, city coat, eyeliner.

balloons.text: Gully told me and nobody else. How is he.
He's in a building with a sign.

image.prompt: close-up of a young woman on a dock at dusk asking something gently, a young man beside her looking at the water

panels.composition: Chloe's hand on the dog. Wood's hand on the dog. Not touching. October 2000 again, five years on, a dock instead of a floor.

image.prompt: close-up of two hands resting on a gray-muzzled dog's back on a dock, not touching each other, dusk light, no words

panels.composition: The three from behind. The dock. Dusk. She's here for four days. The strip gives her one, again.

image.prompt: a young woman and a young man seen from behind at the end of a dock at dusk with a dog between them, small in the frame, watercolor, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: She comes home. 'He's in a building with a sign.' The most the strip ever says about the father.
